description: SettleRef links a structured supplier-payment instruction to a USDC settlement on Arc. The payer signs the exact beneficiary and amount. A capped settlement contract rejects duplicate execution of the same instruction by the same payer. A recipient can import the original instruction and verify the actual transaction and settlement event, then export JSON and CSV reconciliation records. Invoice references and a random commitment salt remain offchain. The experiment does not provide fiat payouts, FX, custody accounts or a bank integration.
